description: Lists the article series published on jwatte.com, the series with the newest article first: the deep-dive series index pages named in the site menu (kind hub) and the numbered multi-part series such as Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3 (kind parts), optionally filtered by keywords. Each entry has the series id, title, kind, link, a short description, the number of articles and the date of its newest article. Includes the total count and next offset; 1 to 25 entries per page.

offset.description: Number of entries before this page, matching the previous next_offset value.

search.description: Optional keywords that must all appear in the series title, description, section headings or article titles, e.g. "yield". Empty means all series.

name: list_series
